Initial commit: NovaForge AI Orchestration Platform

Complete production-ready AI orchestration system featuring:
- Multi-agent coordination (Claude, Copilot, Gemini)
- Fastify-based authentication server with JWT tokens
- PostgreSQL + Redis backend architecture
- Real-time WebSocket communication
- LangGraph workflow orchestration
- Comprehensive testing suite
- Docker containerization support
